description: Create a new task with title, description, status, priority, size, dates, dartboard, assignees, tags, and task relationships. Relationship fields accept industry-standard names (parent, subtasks, blocked_by, blocks, duplicates, related) preferred over deprecated legacy names (parent_task, subtask_ids, blocker_ids, blocking_ids, duplicate_ids, related_ids — removed in 0.13.0). Setting any relationship auto-mirrors the inverse side on the related task (e.g. parent → parent.subtasks). DO NOT encode dependencies as tags like "needs:T-42" or "blocks:T-99" — those are rejected; use the blocked_by / blocks arrays. Returns mirror_applied (inverse-side tasks patched) and mirror_warnings on failure.

blocked_by.description: dart_ids of tasks blocking this one (canonical name; aliases: blocker_ids, depends_on). Auto-mirrors: each gets blocks+=this.

blocks.description: dart_ids of tasks this one blocks (canonical name; alias: blocking_ids). Auto-mirrors: each gets blocked_by+=this.

comment.description: Optional comment to add after creating the task (non-blocking)

duplicates.description: dart_ids of duplicate tasks (canonical name; alias: duplicate_ids). Bidirectional mirror.

parent.description: Parent task dart_id (canonical name; alias: parent_task).

related.description: dart_ids of related (loosely connected) tasks (canonical name; alias: related_ids). Bidirectional mirror.

subtasks.description: dart_ids of child tasks (canonical name; alias: subtask_ids). Auto-mirrors: each child gets parent=this.

name: create_task
